name: Super Superficial
description: Kysy Fischer and the collective ABA NAIA bring Super Superficial to HAU as an independent production in Berlin. The trio of performers poke at superficial beauty standards and preconceived notions of female nudity using skewed, grotesque and comedic choreography. Featuring an improvised score by artist Kriton Beyer, the performance is a riot of sound that challenges conventional representations of the body and femininity.
